name: inspect.software
description: Public record of automated open-source repository audits: security posture, maintainability, dependency health, and malicious-package checks, with a versioned methodology and grade badges. Free tier: full access to all published reports, automatic coverage of repositories above the public-interest threshold (≥500 stars, ≥50 forks, or org-owned with ≥250 stars), embeddable badges, and 100 starting credits (5 inspections) for below-threshold repositories.
